ERR_MCA_SESSION_LOST.title: MCA session lost
ERR_MCA_SESSION_LOST.body: Your mca.gov.in session expired. The autofill cannot continue until you log in again.
remedy: Open the MCA tab and sign in again.
Once the form is visible, come back to this popup and click Retry step.

ERR_FIELD_READONLY.title: Field is read-only
ERR_FIELD_READONLY.body: MCA has locked the field this run tried to write to.
remedy: Check whether a lookup (DIN, CIN) populated the field already.
Skip this field — the run will continue.

ERR_SAVE_REJECTED.title: Save rejected
ERR_SAVE_REJECTED.body: The MCA page rejected the Save step for the current phase.
remedy: Open the Debug tab and run Diagnose Save to see what the page returned.
Fix any validation error reported, then click Retry step.

ERR_IDLE_TIMEOUT.title: Timed out
ERR_IDLE_TIMEOUT.body: The MCA page did not respond within the expected window.
remedy: Check the MCA tab — a modal may be blocking the form.
Click Retry step to try again.

ERR_FRAME_RELOAD.title: MCA page reloaded
ERR_FRAME_RELOAD.body: The form frame reloaded or navigated away mid-run.
remedy: Reopen the AOC-4 form on the MCA tab.
Click Retry step to resume filling from here.

ERR_FIELD_NOT_FOUND.title: Field not found
ERR_FIELD_NOT_FOUND.body: One or more expected fields could not be located on the current page.
remedy: Make sure the correct form is open on MCA.
If the page shows a step picker, open the section this phase targets, then Retry step.

ERR_CLIENT_INVALID.title: Client data is invalid
ERR_CLIENT_INVALID.body: The client JSON is missing a required field for this form.
remedy: Open the client in the Dashboard and complete the required fields.
Re-import the client here, then start the fill again.

ERR_FORM_UNSUPPORTED.title: Form not supported
ERR_FORM_UNSUPPORTED.body: The selected form type has no field map in this extension.
remedy: Pick a supported form (AOC-4, AOC-4 Offline, SPICe+ Part A, INC-32, DIR-3 KYC).
If this looks like a bug, send the Copy report output to Germin8.

ERR_SW_INACTIVE.title: Extension service worker inactive
ERR_SW_INACTIVE.body: The extension background service worker is not responding.
remedy: Reload the extension in chrome://extensions.
Open the MCA form again and click Retry step.

ERR_INJECT_BLOCKED.title: Cannot inject into MCA page
ERR_INJECT_BLOCKED.body: Chrome refused to inject the content script into the current tab.
remedy: Open the AOC-4 form on https://www.mca.gov.in/… directly.
Reload the page with Ctrl+F5 and try again.

ERR_OTP_REQUIRED.title: OTP required
ERR_OTP_REQUIRED.body: This step needs you to enter the OTP shown on your mobile/email.
remedy: Enter the OTP on the MCA tab.
Come back and click Retry step once the OTP is verified.

ERR_UNKNOWN.title: Unexpected error
ERR_UNKNOWN.body: An unexpected error occurred during the autofill.
remedy: Open the Activity log and copy the latest entry.
Click Retry step to try again.
